title: Training Agents 2: Live tutorial on model distillation for training custom agents.
summary: In this live session, we'll cover how to transfer capability from a teacher model to a smaller student through distillation. We'll work through supervised fine-tuning on teacher-generated data, then on-policy and online methods where the teacher scores the student live, then self-distillation where the model teaches itself. Each one runs in TRL.

extra.full_text: In this live session, we'll cover how to transfer capability from a teacher model to a smaller student through distillation. We'll work through supervised fine-tuning on teacher-generated data, then on-policy and online methods where the teacher scores the student live, then self-distillation where the model teaches itself. Each one runs in TRL. What we'll cover: - What distillation is, and the four axes that organize it: signal, data source, timing, and teacher identity - White-box vs black-box: distilling from open weights vs strings - Off-policy distillation: generate from the teacher, then SFT on the outputs - On-policy distillation: sample from the student, score with the teacher in the loop - Distillation as reinforcement learning: the KD distance as a dense, token-level reward - Self-distillation: the model as its own teacher, and when that beats a stronger one Repo: https://github.com/burtenshaw/training-agents This is part of the Training Agents series: using coding agents to design, run, monitor, and review post-training experiments, while training models to become better agents. #TRL #HuggingFace #PostTraining #AIAgents #Distillation

summary: Omron Robotics previewed its next-generation LD-series autonomous mobile robots, the LD-150 and LD-300, at Automate 2026, with shipments expected to begin in the fourth quarter. The new AMRs are aimed at material transport and are described as compact, safety-focused systems that can carry heavier loads, with expanded accessories including ROEX top-mounted payload modules.

extra.full_text: 오므론 로보틱스가 자재 운송 분야에 사용되는 차세대 자율이동로봇(AMR)인 ‘LD’ 시리즈를 오토메이트 2026(6.22~25)에서 소개했다고 오토메이티드웨어하우스가 최근 보도했다.오므론 로보틱스는 확장된 LD 시리즈 AMR용 액세서리로 로엑스(ROEX) 상부탑재물(topper)이 포함된다고 밝혔다. 오므론 로보틱스는 LD-150과 LD-300이 더 무거운 화물을 운송할 수 있으면서도 컴팩트하고 안전하게 설계됐다고 설명했다.오므론은 올해 4분기에 LD-150 및 LD-300 시스템 출하를 시작할 것으로 예상한다고 말했다.캘리포니아주

title: 세계 1만5천 AI 석학들 서울 총 집결… ICML 2026, 한국 AI 위상 높인다
summary: ICML 2026 is being held July 6–11 at Seoul’s COEX, bringing about 15,000 machine learning researchers and industry participants to one of the city’s largest international academic events. The conference covers core AI areas including neural networks, generative AI, large language models, reinforcement learning, computer vision, and robotics, and its scale is being framed as a marker of South Korea’s growing presence in global AI research.

extra.full_text: 세계 최고 권위의 머신러닝 학술대회인 국제머신러닝학회(ICML 2026, International Conference on Machine Learning)가 6일부터 11일까지 6일간 서울 코엑스 전관에서 개최된다. 전 세계 인공지능(AI) 연구자와 기업 관계자 약 1만5000명이 참가하는 이번 행사는 서울에서 열리는 국제 학술행사 가운데 최대 규모 중 하나로 기록될 전망이다.ICML은 신경망, 생성형 AI, 대형언어모델(LLM), 강화학습, 컴퓨터 비전, 로보틱스 등 현대 AI 기술의 핵심 연구 성과가 발표되는 머신러닝 분야 최고
